review_basis: Every exact, NUL-terminated, byte-reversible Shift-JIS ELF symbol containing Japanese script was compared with the five producer-specific message catalogs. The remaining exact-source candidates were classified from their symbol size, raw value, named static references, and owning lookup or producer. Four-byte values resolving to executable addresses are binary pointers, not prose.
